text:
Alex K: deploy-bot blocked the promote job into prod — several pipelines errored during artifact publish. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked -> artifact upload to s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/ failed (incomplete multipart). Holding promotion.

Priya M: CI shows yarn extract errors and truncated tarballs right before upload: `error tar ENODATA` and `unexpected end of file` in the yarn logs. Looks like cached package tarball is truncated.

Dong L: checked the runner host: our cache sweeper ran at the same time as the publish and reclaimed parts of /var/cache/ci/yarn. TTL was recently lowered to 48h for a trial; GC timing overlapped with concurrent builds. GC log: `sweep: removing /var/cache/ci/yarn/pkg-xyz.tgz.part` while upload was streaming.

Riley (oncall): options to unblock: 1) force-promote the last-known-good artifact 2) re-run the release pipeline disabling cache 3) re-run upload with aggressive multipart retries post-abort.

Alex K: prefer smallest blast radius: pin to last-good artifact for the window and continue investigation. What is last-good artifact id?

deploy-bot: Last successful promotion: redwood-app-2026-03-19-v2.tar.gz (sha256:45be9f2d) and image ghcr.io/redwood-inference/service-api@sha256:aa11bb22.

Priya M: I'll validate the artifact checksum before promote: `sha256sum redwood-app-2026-03-19-v2.tar.gz` -> expecting 45be9f2d.

Dong L: I'll pause the cache sweeper and open an infra ticket to schedule GC windows away from release jobs. Also adding a pre-publish file lock on the cache directory to avoid mid-upload removals.

Alex K: action plan: 1) pin to last-good artifact now, 2) rerun full pipeline with `YARN_CACHE_DISABLED=1` to build a fresh artifact, 3) once verified, promote the new artifact and unpause GC. Priya validate, Dong promote, Riley coordinate windows.

Priya M: validating checksum now.

deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested.

Dong L: running promote command: `./scripts/promote --env prod --artifact redwood-app-2026-03-19-v2.tar.gz --force`

deploy-bot: Promotion executed; health checks running.

Priya M: checksum OK (45be9f2d).

Dong L: promote finished, prod health green. Rerunning release pipeline with `YARN_CACHE_DISABLED=1` (adds ~10m).

Priya M: rebuild finished and uploaded successfully, new artifact sha256: 9f8e7d6c. Verified.

Riley (oncall): cache sweeper paused until infra confirms non-overlapping windows. Filing follow-up: add pre-upload lock and multipart-complete retry in deploy scripts.

Alex K: documenting in release notes: pinned old artifact to preserve SLO, then promoted fresh artifact after safe rebuild. Postmortem + infra ticket will capture GC scheduling change.

Priya M: added logs and checksums to postmortem draft.

Dong L: added small retry/abort step to deploy script to clear incomplete multipart parts before attempting new upload — should reduce future impact.

Riley (oncall): closing thread — reopen if upload errors reappear. :white_check_mark:
